title: "Generate the Excelsheet for Vehicle Composition - 2"
author: "Matthias Roesslein - Empa"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B %Y')`"
tags: [FutuRaM, Empa, vehicles, car, van, new data, 1980 - 2050]
abstract: |
  All the code to fill in and generate the datasets for FutuRaM data template. This is for all the new data from 2010 to 2030.
  Replace extrusion, forging and sheet aluminium with the respectiv material classes of wroughtaluminium. 
  - Extrusion aluminium allowys consist mainly of EN AW-6XXX series
  - Forging aluminium alloys consist mainly of EN AW-2XXX series
  - Sheet aluminium alloys consists minly of EN AW-5XXX series
  
  Handles data between 1980 and 2050
  
version 3.0.0
 - 2.0.5: There were a number of minor errors. All have been corrected (not yet)
 - 2.1.0: Additional modifications to have again a full dataset. Intergration of rest material will be done in the next version

fontsize: 12pt
output:
  pdf_document: default
    df_print: paged

# Get all the datasets needed and the fill them into the FutuRaM Dat template

## Loading of the libraries

We are using tidyverse framework to rearrange and analysis the data. 

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(forcats)

library(readxl) # read excel files
library("openxlsx")   #The openxlsx package is highly customizable and allows you to: Write multiple data frames to different sheets of the same Excel file. Customize formatting, such as column widths, bold headers, and colors.

```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
tidyverse_conflicts()
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
count <- c(0)

Layer_4 <- c("layer 4")
```

# Get all the data, which are required

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
filename12_input <- "Data/12_VehicleCompositionDataBase.xlsx"      # Different Keys, which are required to put together the composition data
filename13_input <- "Data/13_VehicleCompositionAdditionalInformation.xlsx"   # Additional information to complete the composition data

filename22_input <- "Data/22_MaterialElementComposition.xlsx"  # Exact material composition
filename23_input <- "Data/23_CompositionDataUpdated.xlsx"

futuram_output <- "CompositionData/ELV_2010_2050.xlsx"
futuram_output_short <- "CompositionData/ELV_2010_2050_short.xlsx"

ProductKeyLevel1   <- read_excel(filename12_input, sheet = "productKeyLevel1")
ProductKeyLevel2   <- read_excel(filename12_input, sheet = "productKeyLevel2")

ComponentKeyLevel0 <- read_excel(filename12_input, sheet = "componentKeyLevel0")
ComponentKeyLevel1 <- read_excel(filename12_input, sheet = "componentKeyLevel1")

MaterialKeyLevel0 <- read_excel(filename12_input, sheet = "materialKeyLevel0")
MaterialKeyLevel1 <- read_excel(filename12_input, sheet = "materialKeyLevel1")
MaterialKeyLevel2 <- read_excel(filename12_input, sheet = "materialKeyLevel2")
MaterialKeyLevel3 <- read_excel(filename12_input, sheet = "materialKeyLevel3")
MaterialKeyLevel4 <- read_excel(filename12_input, sheet = "materialKeyLevel4")

Compositioncatalyst <- read_excel(filename12_input, sheet = "catalyst")

AdditionalInformation <- read_excel(filename13_input, sheet = "additioanlInformation")

CompositioncastAluminium <- read_excel(filename22_input, sheet = "materialAlCast1composition")
CompositionextrudedAluminium <- read_excel(filename22_input, sheet = "materialAlExtrusioncomposition")
CompositionforgedAluminium <- read_excel(filename22_input, sheet = "materialAlForgingcomposition")
CompositionsheetAluminium <- read_excel(filename22_input, sheet = "materialAlSheetcomposition")

CompositioncastIron <- read_excel(filename22_input, sheet = "materialsFeCastIroncomposition")
CompositionmildSteel <- read_excel(filename22_input, sheet = "materialsFeMildSteelcomposition")
CompositionHSSteel <- read_excel(filename22_input, sheet = "materialsFeHSSteelcomposition")
CompositionUHSSteel <- read_excel(filename22_input, sheet = "materialsFeUHSSteelcomposition")
CompositionAHSSteel <- read_excel(filename22_input, sheet = "materialsFeAHSSteelcomposition")

CompositionMgAlloys <- read_excel(filename22_input, sheet = "materialsMgAlloyscomposition")

Compositionactuator <- read_excel(filename22_input, sheet = "materialsPCBsActcomposition")
CompositioncableLike <- read_excel(filename22_input, sheet = "materialscableInscomposition")
Compositioncontroller <- read_excel(filename22_input, sheet = "materialsPCBsContcomposition")
Compositionlight <- read_excel(filename22_input, sheet = "materialsPCBsLightscomposition")
CompositionpowerElectronic <- read_excel(filename22_input, sheet = "materialsPCBsPowerelcomposition")

CompositionpermanentMagnet <- read_excel(filename22_input, sheet = "materialsPerMagnetcomposition")
CompositionengineCable <- read_excel(filename22_input, sheet = "materialscableEngcomposition")
CompositiongeneratorpermanentMagnet <- read_excel(filename22_input, sheet = "materialsGenPerMagcomposition")
CompositiongeneratorCable <- read_excel(filename22_input, sheet = "materialscableGencomposition")

calculate <- read_excel(filename23_input, sheet = "FutuRaM-ELV")

```

# Define and prepare, which data from the new data should be added to the FutuRaM template

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

emptyValue <- "N/A"     # ""

vehicleNumber_PetrolDiesel <- 26 #26  # Is set during the development process - set how many cars should be put into the data template  # 13 petrol; 26 petrol & diesel
vehicleNumber_BEV <- 13  #13 Is set during the development process - set how many cars should be put into the data template  # 13 petrol; 26 petrol & diesel
vehicleNumber_HEV_PHEV <- 26 #26  # Is set during the development process - set how many cars should be put into the data template  # 13 petrol; 26 petrol & diesel
vehicleNumber_Others <- 13 #13  # Is set during the development process - set how many cars should be put into the data template  # 13 petrol; 26 petrol & diesel

# Product keys

productID <- 1 # needs to be provided from VehicleCompositionDataset_1.Rmd

productKeyLevel1 <- ProductKeyLevel1$productKeyLevel1   
ProductKeyLevel1Length <- length(ProductKeyLevel1$productKeyLevel1)
productKeyLevel1Index <- 1 # 1 Petrol, 2 diesel, 3 BEV, 4 HEV, 5 PHEV, 6 Others

productKeyLevel2 <- ProductKeyLevel2$productKeyLevel2
productKeyLevel2Index <- 1  # 1-13 Petrol, 14 - 26 Diesel, 27 - 39 BEV, 40 - 52 HEV, 53 - 65 PHEV, 66 - 78 Others

durationYear <- c(1980, 2050)
predictionYear <- 2026 # Change szenario and also measure to perdiction
productionYear <- c(durationYear[1]:durationYear[2])
yearLength <- durationYear[2] - durationYear[1] + 1
YearIndex <- 1

componentID <- 1

componentIndex <- 0    # total number (21) of components handle with this code

componentKeyLevel0 <- ComponentKeyLevel0$componentKeyLevel0
componentKeyLevel0Index <- 1

componentKeyLevel1 <- ComponentKeyLevel1$componentKeyLevel1
componentKeyLevel1Length <- length(componentKeyLevel1)
componentKeyLevel1Index <- 0

materialKeyLevel0 <- MaterialKeyLevel0$materialKeyLevel0
materialKeyLevel0Length <- length(materialKeyLevel0)
materialKeyLevel0Index <- 0

materialKeyLevel1 <- MaterialKeyLevel1$materialKeyLevel1
materialKeyLevel1Length <- length(materialKeyLevel1)
materialKeyLevel1Index <- 0

materialKeyLevel2 <- MaterialKeyLevel2$materialKeyLevel2
materialKeyLevel2Length <- length(materialKeyLevel2)
materialKeyLevel2Index <- 0

materialKeyLevel3 <- MaterialKeyLevel3$materialKeyLevel3
materialKeyLevel3Length <- length(materialKeyLevel3)
materialKeyLevel3Index <- 0

materialKeyLevel4 <- MaterialKeyLevel4$materialKeyLevel4
materialKeyLevel4Length <- length(materialKeyLevel4)
materialKeyLevel4Index <- 0

cpIndex <- 0

materialElement_castAluminium <- CompositioncastAluminium %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_castAluminiumLength <- nrow(materialElement_castAluminium)

materialElement_extrudedAluminium <- CompositionextrudedAluminium %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_extrudedAluminiumLength <- nrow(materialElement_extrudedAluminium)

materialElement_forgedAluminium <- CompositionforgedAluminium %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_forgedAluminiumLength <- nrow(materialElement_forgedAluminium)

materialElement_sheetAluminium <- CompositionsheetAluminium %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_sheetAluminiumLength <- nrow(materialElement_sheetAluminium)

materialElement_castIron <- CompositioncastIron %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_castIronLength <- nrow(materialElement_castIron)

materialElement_mildSteel <- CompositionmildSteel %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_mildSteelLength <- nrow(materialElement_mildSteel)

materialElement_HSS <- CompositionHSSteel %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_HSSLength <- nrow(materialElement_HSS)

materialElement_AHSS <- CompositionAHSSteel %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_AHSSLength <- nrow(materialElement_AHSS)

materialElement_UHSS <- CompositionUHSSteel %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_UHSSLength <- nrow(materialElement_UHSS)

materialElement_magnesium <- CompositionMgAlloys %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_magnesiumLength <- nrow(materialElement_magnesium)

materialElement_catalyst <- Compositioncatalyst$Element
materialElement_catalystLength <- length(materialElement_catalyst)

materialElement_actuator <- Compositionactuator %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_actuatorLength <- nrow(materialElement_actuator)

materialElement_cableLike <- CompositioncableLike %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_cableLikeLength <- nrow(materialElement_cableLike)

materialElement_controller <- Compositioncontroller %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_controllerLength <- nrow(materialElement_controller)

materialElement_light <- Compositionlight %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_lightLength <- nrow(materialElement_light)

materialElement_powerElectronic <- CompositionpowerElectronic %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_powerElectronicLength <- nrow(materialElement_powerElectronic)

materialElement_permanentMagnet <- CompositionpermanentMagnet %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_permanentMagnetLength <- nrow(materialElement_permanentMagnet)

materialElement_engineCable <- CompositionengineCable %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_engineCableLength <- nrow(materialElement_engineCable)

materialElement_generatorPermanentMagnet <- CompositiongeneratorpermanentMagnet %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_generatorPermanentMagnetLength <- nrow(materialElement_generatorPermanentMagnet)

materialElement_generatorCable <- CompositiongeneratorCable %>% filter(limits == "mean")  %>% select(Element)
materialElement_generatorCableLength <- nrow(materialElement_generatorCable)

ElementIndex <- 0

emptyData <- "N/A"

parameterCode <- c("e-p", "e-c", "e-m", "m-p", "m-c", "c-p")
parameterCodeIndex <- 6

parameter <- c("mass", "massFraction")
parameterIndex <- 1

test <- productKeyLevel2[productKeyLevel2Index]
dataAdd <- calculate %>% filter(productKeyLevel2 == test)

unitOfMeasurementValue <- c("kg/unit", "g/unit")
unitOfMeasurementValueIndex <- 1

uncertaintyIndex <- 1    # pertrol = 1, diesel = 236, BEV = 470, HEV = 743, PHEV = 1042, Others = 1340
reliability <- AdditionalInformation %>% filter(Alloy == AdditionalInformation$Alloy[uncertaintyIndex] & ProductKeyLevel2 == AdditionalInformation$ProductKeyLevel2[uncertaintyIndex])

referenceIndex <- 1
references <- AdditionalInformation %>% filter(Alloy == AdditionalInformation$Alloy[referenceIndex] & ProductKeyLevel2 == AdditionalInformation$ProductKeyLevel2[referenceIndex])

licenceIndex <- 1       # CC BY-NC
licences <- AdditionalInformation %>% filter(Alloy == AdditionalInformation$Alloy[licenceIndex] & ProductKeyLevel2 == AdditionalInformation$ProductKeyLevel2[licenceIndex])

noteIndex <- 1
notes <- AdditionalInformation %>% filter(Alloy == AdditionalInformation$Alloy[noteIndex] & ProductKeyLevel2 == AdditionalInformation$ProductKeyLevel2[noteIndex])

urlIndex <- 1
urlAdress <-AdditionalInformation %>% filter(Alloy == AdditionalInformation$Alloy[urlIndex] & ProductKeyLevel2 == AdditionalInformation$ProductKeyLevel2[urlIndex])

# Create a new workbook
wb1 <- createWorkbook()
wb2 <- createWorkbook()

tab_name <- "petrolCar_1980_2050"
addWorksheet(wb1, tab_name)
addWorksheet(wb2, tab_name)

startRow <- 1
```

# Start filling the different columns and rows with data
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Define loop to fill the data
# Use the repeat loop, because it is difficult to calculate how many loops are require

# set condition
loopEnd <- as.integer(round((yearLength * 191) * vehicleNumber_PetrolDiesel))   # Petrol & Diesel
loopEnd_BEV <- as.integer(round((yearLength * 212) * vehicleNumber_BEV))   # BEV 204
loopEnd_HEV_PHEV <- (yearLength * 232) *  vehicleNumber_HEV_PHEV   # HEV & PHEV
loopEnd_Other <- (yearLength * 211) * vehicleNumber_Others   # Other

loopEnd <- loopEnd + loopEnd_BEV + loopEnd_HEV_PHEV + loopEnd_Other

count <- 1

for (i in 1:loopEnd) {
  
  #print(i)
  
  data01 <- count      #dataEntryID
  data_short00 <- data01
  
  data02 <- "ELV"  #relatedFutuRaM-WS
  data03 <- "use"  #use/EoL
  data04 <- emptyValue    #uinqueStockOrFlowName
  data05 <- 0    #LoWchapter
  data06 <- emptyValue   #LoWsubChapter
  data07 <- emptyValue   #LoWkey
  data08 <- emptyValue   #ISRI
  data09 <- emptyValue   #HS
  data10 <- emptyValue   #collectionCategory
  
  if (productionYear[YearIndex] < predictionYear) {
    data_short01 <- "OBS"
  }
  else {
    data_short01 <- "BAU/REC/CIR"
  }
  
  
  #data11 <- NA  #productID
  data11 <- productID
  
  #data12 <- "elvUnknown"   #productKeyLevel1
  data12 <- productKeyLevel1[productKeyLevel1Index]
  
  #data13 <- "V01000000"    #productKeyLevel2
  data13 <- productKeyLevel2[productKeyLevel2Index]
  data_short05 <- productKeyLevel2[productKeyLevel2Index]
  
  data14 <- emptyValue      #productKeyLevel3
  data15 <- emptyValue      #productDescriptionFromDataSource
  data16 <- 2       #similarityBetweenProductDescriptionAndKey
  
  #data17 <- "1980"  #productionYear
  data17 <- productionYear[YearIndex]
  data_short02 <- productionYear[YearIndex]
  
  data_short03 <- "EU27+4"
  data_short04 <- "ELV_POM"
    
  data18 <- emptyValue      #yearEntryEOLphase
  
  #data19 <- NA      #componentID
  data19 <- componentID
  
  #data20 <- ""      #componentKeyLevel0
  if(componentKeyLevel0Index == 0) {
    data20 <- emptyValue
    data_short06 <- data20
  }
  else {
    data20 <- componentKeyLevel0[componentKeyLevel0Index]
    data_short06 <- data20   # needs likely more code
  }
  
  if(componentKeyLevel1Index == 0) {
    data21 <- emptyValue      #componentKeyLevel1
  }
  else if(componentKeyLevel1Index > 0) {
    data21 <- componentKeyLevel1[componentKeyLevel1Index]      #componentKeyLevel1
    data_short06 <- data21   # needs likely more code
  }
  
  data22 <- emptyValue      #componentKeyLevel2
  data23 <- emptyValue      #componentDescriptionFromDataSource
  data24 <- 2       #similarityBetweenComponentDescriptionAndKey
  data25 <- emptyValue      #embeddedComponent
  
  #data26 <- ""      #materialKeyLevel0
  if(materialKeyLevel0Index == 0) {
    data26 <- emptyValue
    data_short07 <- data26
  }
  else {
    data26 <- materialKeyLevel0[materialKeyLevel0Index]
    data_short07 <- data26
  }
  
  #data27 <- ""      #materialKeyLevel1
  if(materialKeyLevel1Index == 0) {
    data27 <- emptyData
  }
  else {
    data27 <- materialKeyLevel1[materialKeyLevel1Index]
    data_short07 <- data27
  }
  
  #data28 <- ""      #materialKeyLevel2
  if(materialKeyLevel2Index == 0) {
    data28 <- emptyData
  }
  else {
    data28 <- materialKeyLevel2[materialKeyLevel2Index]
    data_short07 <- data28
  }
  
  #data29 <- ""      #materialKeyLevel3
  if(materialKeyLevel3Index == 0) {
    data29 <- emptyData
  }
  else {
    data29 <- materialKeyLevel3[materialKeyLevel3Index]
    data_short07 <- data29
  }
  
  #data30 <- ""      #materialKeyLevel4
  if(materialKeyLevel4Index == 0) {
    data30 <- emptyData
  }
  else {
    data30 <- materialKeyLevel4[materialKeyLevel4Index]
    data_short07 <- data30
  }
  
  data31 <- emptyData      #materialDescriptionFromDataSource
  data32 <- 2       #similarityBetweenMaterialDescriptionAndKey
  
  if(componentIndex == 0) {
    data33 <- emptyData      #element
  }
  else if(componentIndex == 1) {   # castAl
    if(ElementIndex == 0) {
      data33 <- emptyData      #element
    }
    else if(ElementIndex > 0) {
      tempElement <- materialElement_castAluminium$Element[ElementIndex]
      if(tempElement == "otherOrUndefinedElements_") {
        tempElement <- "otherOrUndefinedElements"
      }
      data33 <- tempElement
    }
  }
  else if(componentIndex == 2) {   #extruded Al
    if(ElementIndex == 0) {
      data33 <- emptyData      #element
    }
    else if(ElementIndex > 0) {
      tempElement <- materialElement_extrudedAluminium$Element[ElementIndex]
      if(tempElement == "otherOrUndefinedElements_") {
        tempElement <- "otherOrUndefinedElements"
      }
      data33 <- tempElement
    }
  }
  else if(componentIndex == 3) {   # fordged Al
    if(ElementIndex == 0) {
      data33 <- emptyData      #element
    }
    else if(ElementIndex > 0) {
      tempElement <- materialElement_forgedAluminium$Element[ElementIndex]
      if(tempElement == "otherOrUndefinedElements_") {
        tempElement <- "otherOrUndefinedElements"
      }
      data33 <- tempElement
    }
  }
  else if(componentIndex == 4) {     # sheet Al
    if(ElementIndex == 0) {
      data33 <- emptyData      #element
    }
    else if(ElementIndex > 0) {
      tempElement<- materialElement_sheetAluminium$Element[ElementIndex]
      if(tempElement == "otherOrUndefinedElements_") {
        tempElement <- "otherOrUndefinedElements"
      }
      data33 <- tempElement
    }
  }

  else if(componentIndex == 5) {   # castIron
    if(ElementIndex == 0) {
      data33 <- emptyData      #element
    }
    else if(ElementIndex > 0) {
      data33 <- materialElement_castIron$Element[ElementIndex]
    }
  }
  else if(componentIndex == 6) {   #mildSteel
    if(ElementIndex == 0) {
      data33 <- emptyData      #element
    }
    else if(ElementIndex > 0) {
      data33 <- materialElement_mildSteel$Element[ElementIndex]
    }
  }
  else if(componentIndex == 7) {   #HSS
    if(ElementIndex == 0) {
      data33 <- emptyData      #element
    }
    else if(ElementIndex > 0) {
      data33 <- materialElement_HSS$Element[ElementIndex]
    }
  }
  else if(componentIndex == 8) {   #AHSS
    if(ElementIndex == 0) {
      data33 <- emptyData      #element
    }
    else if(ElementIndex > 0) {
      data33 <- materialElement_AHSS$Element[ElementIndex]
    }
  }
  else if(componentIndex == 9) {   #UHSS
    if(ElementIndex == 0) {
      data33 <- emptyData      #element
    }
    else if(ElementIndex > 0) {
      data33 <- materialElement_UHSS$Element[ElementIndex]
    }
  }
  else if(componentIndex == 10) {   #magnesiumAlloys
    if(ElementIndex == 0) {
      data33 <- emptyData      #element
    }
    else if(ElementIndex > 0) {
      data33 <- materialElement_magnesium$Element[ElementIndex]
    }
  }
  else if(componentIndex == 11) {   # catalyst
    if(ElementIndex == 0) {
      data33 <- emptyData      #element
    }
    else if(ElementIndex > 0) {
      data33 <- materialElement_catalyst[ElementIndex]
    }
  }
  else if(componentIndex == 12) {    # ElectronicsActuators
    if(ElementIndex == 0) {
      data33 <- emptyData      #element
    }
    else if(ElementIndex > 0) {
      data33 <- materialElement_actuator$Element[ElementIndex]
    }
  }
  else if(componentIndex == 13) {   # ElectronicsCables
    if(ElementIndex == 0) {
      data33 <- emptyData      #element
    }
    else if(ElementIndex > 0) {
      data33 <- materialElement_cableLike$Element[ElementIndex]
    }
```
